Package Model.World

Class HexWorld

java.lang.Object
Model.World.HexWorld
All Implemented Interfaces:
HexWorldInterface
public class HexWorld extends Object implements HexWorldInterface
This class represents a hex world. It offers all the operations mandated by the Model.HexWorld.HexWorld interface.
